answer: Locks are logged in horizon, expire in oasis, and fable lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 108 aliases therefore needs 94 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2442 identities would post 1030 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
